direction: A film is a function of time: the viewer should feel precision and play, like watching a very good instrument being tuned.

devices.name: the line
devices.purpose: one accent stroke carries the eye from type to graph to container: the film never hard-cuts

devices.name: mono readouts
devices.purpose: code-like labels (t, frame counts, scores) prove it is a program

devices.name: designed wipes
devices.purpose: band wipe and iris instead of cross-fades

reference: grammar of product-film UI motion: one element transforming, cursor-driven, warm neutral canvas, one accent
